body.html:
Design feedback · round 7 · N-screens

Five of the seven asks land — and the prototype went interactive

Seventh package, reviewed by clicking through it: the v4 prototype is now a working clickable app with a context-morphing sidebar, and it delivers five of the seven screens requested in the Netlify/Vercel asks — the logs viewer, the site-settings home, the honest cost dashboard, lock-production, and the import flow. DNS editor and redirects (N-06/N-07) are correctly absent, waiting on their seam tasks. Verdict: all five approved; the cost dashboard and logs footer are the two best pieces of product copy in the whole remake.

Verified interactively, screen by screen

AskWhat the prototype doesAssessment
N-03 · Usage & costNew Usage item in the workspace nav. "Projected next invoice · 12 August — €25.80 — Supporter €12.00 + servers €13.80 — *no usage line items, ever*." Per-instance rows (€4.90, €8.90 /mo) with site attribution; footer: "Prices are the provider's own — Hetzner's live EUR catalog, Azure's retail cache. Archived instances cost €0; the archive bundle is included in your plan."Approved — the identity flagship, worded better than the brief. Numbers are internally consistent. "Your bill previewed, not estimated" should become marketing copy.
N-01 · Logs viewerInstance Logs tab: source chips (all / journal / caddy per site), level + HTTP-status colors, repeated 14× today coalescing on a 404, a Following live-tail toggle, and the footer: "journalctl -n 200 + Caddy access log — streamed from your box on demand, nothing stored on our side." A site-scoped Logs tab exists too.Approved. The footer states the exact real mechanism (the agent's logs command) AND a privacy contract — the build must keep both true: on-demand relay, no control-plane log retention.
N-04 · Lock production"Lock production" on the Deployments card; locked state (clicked, works): amber banner "Production is locked to deploy #42. Git pushes and Studio publishes are recorded but held — nothing builds or switches until you unlock."Approved. Both loops held, target deploy named, reversal obvious. Stronger than Netlify's stop-auto-publishing, as intended.
N-02 · Site settings homeSite context now has its own sub-nav: Deployments · Git · Domains · Environment · Settings · Logs. Delete-site confirm carries the content-first contract: "Removes deploys, previews and domain routing. The dataset and all its content stay on <instance>."Approved. That deletion sentence is doctrine gold — a site dies, content survives, stated plainly.
N-05 · Import front doornewSiteMode flow in the prototype: framework "detected from astro.config.mjs", "webhook registers automatically · main → production", "webhook registered, first build queued."Approved on copy (flow not fully toured). Sequencing guard applies: auto-webhook language is true only post-gh-1.
N-06 / N-07DNS records editor and redirects — absent; Domains tab shows the rung checklist only.Correctly sequenced — both wait on seam additions per the asks paper.

Structural news

• The prototype is now interactive — nav, tabs, lock/unlock state flips all work. Future reviews are click-throughs, not render inspection; ask for exported renders only for the matrix.
• Context-morphing sidebar: entering an instance or site swaps the sidebar to that thing's sub-nav with a "← Fleet / ← All sites" exit. Good pattern — one obligation: #instance/<id> and #site/<id> anchors must deep-link into these contexts.
• Server IPs joined the metadata line (fsn1 · cx22 · 5.75.169.183 · …) — the named-box identity made concrete. Keep.
• The instance Overview tab is now the composed D-03 (golden path with "checks run from Falkenstein every 5 minutes", updates card with pause/pin/rollback, sites, identity/runtime) — the outline's last big "partial" is effectively designed.
Ledger after round 7
Of the 61-surface outline: N-01…N-05 move to Designed; D-03 composes; N-06/N-07 stay queued on seams; concept trio (Forms, preview-feedback-to-tasks, analytics) still awaits the owner call on Forms. Designer throughput this cycle has been extraordinary — the constraint is now entirely on our side: gh-1 App registration, seam tasks, tokens emit, and the build epics.

Reviewed 2026-07-18 by interactive walkthrough of "UI improvement discussion (7).zip". Chain: ten-screen asks · auto-deploy target UI · build outline.
